verdict.rationale: Fellow documents configurable organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention. Its Super Admin API can delete data across the workspace, including a note-deletion endpoint, to support privacy-regulation erasure. Both retention control and deletion are first-party capabilities, but API deletion is limited to Enterprise super admins, and the retention policies appear only as marketing-level claims. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring retention policies (granularity, per-data-type scope), deletion control for non-admin users or plans other than Enterprise, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained

Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes and to erase third‑party data in line with privacy regulations.
Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API.
